selection: Keep both Cortex_Shell meshes visible; show only selected ROI label_ids. Hide unselected ROI meshes. Do not show all 20 on load.
fallback_materials: Basic translucent glTF PBR only; Blender compositor/Fresnel network is NOT embedded. Use supplied GLSL reference and tune in target renderer.

attributes._nervis_micro: float [0,1], baked fine surface variation; emission *= .48+1.45*micro, alpha *= .8+.65*micro
attributes._nervis_edge: float [0,1], inward ROI feather: 0 boundary, 1 interior
attributes._nervis_context: float [0,1], reduced opacity of medial context walls; ROI is 1

signal.zero: Selected region remains visible. Selection is independent of signal.
signal.data: No timeseries in model. Host app supplies normalized display strength; magnitude is not proof of activation increase.

compositing.blender: AgX, exposure 0; Fog Glow quality High, threshold 1, strength .28, size .25
compositing.web: Implement bloom separately; Blender node Size does not directly map to a Three.js bloom radius. Match actual renders.

particles.reproduction: Sample current visible surface; use seeded sampling, small additive points, depth-tested. Do not recreate voxel masks or use patient inputs.

render_notes: Use actual normals; do not use wireframe triangle edges.
Retain backface attenuation and inward edge feather.
Do not force selected regions to render over all depth.
Transparent surfaces can require explicit front/back passes and sorting; verify 360-degree orbit.
Default displayed example: IDs 2 and 12, strength .6.
GLSL reference is a porting reference, not a tested frontend integration.
